items.q5: I usually plan my work every morning. I spend about ten minutes reviewing my schedule and deciding which tasks I need to finish first.
items.q6: I use a digital calendar because it helps me keep track of deadlines. I also set reminders so that I do not miss important meetings.
items.q7: I think setting priorities is the most effective way to manage time. For example, last week I had several meetings and an urgent report to finish. I completed the report first and moved a less important task to the next day. As a result, I met my deadline without working late.
